lin.name: Figure Ground

changes: headings in sentence case at a light weight and a large size, labels in small caps: a magazine's hierarchy
all capitals limited to one role (tiny labels), each with about +0.06em tracking
tracking tuned per size: display titles tighter (about -0.02em), small labels and caps looser (+0.04 to +0.08em)

lin.idea: the family's operator manual: every section led by a figure drawn from its own data (Status as the wiring of keys and connections with lit ports, the chat as a sequence diagram, To do's due dates on a line with NOW, Home's family tree to Vera to its counts)
